evidence.excerpt: Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains.
